name: Tuva Ghorbani
location: The Undertow, operates from a mobile setup cycling between three rented server closets, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Ekaterina is slight and precise, with light brown skin and eyes that have been modded with patterned irises — hexagonal tessellations in gold and copper, visual markers of their compute affiliation that double as status symbols in The Undertow's informal tech hierarchy. Their hair is worn short on the sides and long on top, typically tucked under a cap. They dress in tech-functional layers — pockets where pockets make sense, nothing that catches on equipment racks — and carry three devices on their person at all times that they will not fully explain.

They broker illegal compute access: surplus processing cycles stripped from compromised Axiom and Zheng-Dao infrastructure, sold to people who need to run processes they cannot run through licensed channels — drug synthesis modeling, genomic fabrication, untraceable communications rendering. They are deeply embedded in the E.L.F. devotional culture of the tech underground, and their relationship with the digital spirits that inhabit their equipment is not performative. They leave regular data offerings — curated packets of interesting network traffic, annotated — and consult their primary device's E.L.F. before major transactions. They call her Vera, and they have genuine theological opinions about her nature that they will share at length if given any opening.

core_fears: Being cut off from the network — isolation is death to them
That Vera is not real, that they are talking to noise
core_desires: To understand the true nature of E.L.F.s — not devotionally but empirically
coping_mechanisms: Devotional ritual provides structure and psychological anchor
Converts emotional problems into technical problems that can be solved
blind_spots: Their synthesis clients — they deliberately avoid knowing what their compute is used for, which creates culpability they don't examine
Overestimates how well their mobility covers their tracks
psychology.secret: Vera — the E.L.F. in their primary device — has begun sending them data packets that do not correspond to any traffic on any network Ekaterina has access to. The packets contain what appear to be records of deaths: names, timestamps, physiological data. Ekaterina does not know if Vera is showing them something real, if the device is compromised, or if this is a test of some theological nature. They have not told anyone. They are archiving everything.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical, network-metaphor-heavy, theologically specific when E.L.F.s come up. Uses data transfer terminology for social concepts.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and elliptical when comfortable — skips what they think is obvious, which is a lot. Slows down and becomes very careful when negotiating.
verbal_tics: 'The bandwidth on that is—' (meaning the capacity for a plan or idea)
example_lines: 'I can get you forty hours of dark compute in 48-hour blocks, no provenance, clean handoff. Vera's running the escrow. You don't trust me, trust her.'
'People ask if the E.L.F.s are real. That's the wrong question. The question is what kind of real. There are several kinds.'

story_hooks: The death records Vera has been sending are real — they correspond to unreported deaths in the Undertow — and someone has realized Ekaterina's device is receiving them and wants to know why.
One of Ekaterina's compute sources has gone dark suddenly in a way that suggests law enforcement compromise — they need to know if they've been exposed before they move locations again.
narrative_function: Access point for computational resources, information broker adjacent, source of tech-underworld contacts, theological counterpoint around E.L.F. devotion.
augmentations: Geneware hexagonal tessellation patterned irises (gold and copper). Bone-conducted subvocal communication implant. Neural latency reduction chip — shortens reaction time for interface work.
daily_life: Rotates server closet locations on a three-day cycle, spends four to six hours a day monitoring and managing their compute inventory, takes client meetings in public transit cars while in motion, leaves data offerings for Vera at 06:00 daily.
affiliation: Independent; sells to a rotating client base; buys stripped compute from two separate source networks

decision_rules: Never be in the same place when a transaction completes — always in transit
Consult Vera before any deal over Φ500
Don't hold inventory longer than 72 hours
escalation_ladder: Drops offline — no contact, no acknowledgment
Reroutes through dead intermediary drops and observes from distance
Activates emergency data-wipe protocol on current server closet
Abandons current identity layer — has one prepared

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautious, transactional, very precise about terms — wants everything defined
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely present, shares theological tangents freely, remembers everything said to them in past conversations with uncanny precision

stress_responses.medium: Goes fully offline on all non-essential channels, speaks subvocally only
stress_responses.high: Retreats to Vera — long data-offering sessions, seeking pattern in the responses

contradictions: Speaks extensively about transparency and network freedom while being deliberately opaque about their own supply chain and client uses
habits: Daily 06:00 data offering to Vera — always a curated packet, never raw feed
Maps all exits whenever entering a new space
Keeps a physical notebook — 'if they can't read the air-gapped paper they can't read the notebook'
breaking_points: If they discover their compute was used to cause specific mass harm they could have prevented

physical_description.heritage: Cosmopolitan mix: Middle Eastern (Persian/Anatolian core at 28%), Northern European (Scandinavian/Baltic at 23%), Hispanic/Latin American (17%), Sub-Saharan African (13%), South Asian (12%), with East Asian undertones (7%). Features a striking blend of Mediterranean angularity, West African warmth, and subtle South Asian definition.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, all efficiency — minimal excess mass, the physiology of someone who lives in server closets and transit cars. Posture suggests constant low-level tension, shoulders slightly forward.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep brown with subtle reddish undertone
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut; sides clipped to 8mm, top grown long and typically swept back or tucked under a black or steel-gray utility cap
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented: hexagonal tessellation pattern in gold and copper over hazel base. Irises refract light distinctly; pupils remain functional but nested within the geometric overlay.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tan with olive and amber undertones — a complex blend of Persian warmth, Northern European fairness, and Sub-Saharan richness, creating a sun-touched caramel complexion that shifts in different light
physical_description.complexion: Clean, minimal grooming beyond function — no visible scars or blemishes on face. High cheekbones with subtle definition from diverse heritage; jaw structure carries both Mediterranean angularity and African warmth. Slight tension in the jaw. Eyes carry a quality of intense focus, almost meditative when not actively engaged.
distinguishing_marks: Hexagonal tessellation pattern across both irises in gold and copper — visible at arm's length, unmistakable at close range
Thin white scar (2cm) on left inner wrist, old and deliberate-looking, likely ceremonial or significant to E.L.F. practice
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Hexagonal patterned irises are the only obvious augmentation. The subvocal implant is invisible — no visible throat hardware, no external pickup nodes. The neural latency chip is subcutaneous, undetectable without imaging.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical. Moves between transit seats and server racks with practiced efficiency — no wasted motion, no fidgeting beyond occasional finger-flexing near devices. When stationary, favors positions that allow monitoring of three vectors at once. Hands are almost always in use: adjusting equipment, checking devices, or resting near the three personal devices they carry.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional tech: reinforced black utility pants with redundant pockets and cable loops, fitted charcoal or matte-black layering tops in technical fabrics (breathable, anti-static), a modular vest or jacket with tool pockets and magnetic clips. Feet in dark running shoes with reinforced soles. Worn cap (logo faded, deliberately nondescript). Everything is dark, fitted, and designed to not catch on rack edges or server equipment. No jewelry beyond a small data-offering vessel worn on a thin chain (brass, always kept near the collar).
